close_reason: All children done; live local captions verified fast on device
description:
Local provider problems (2026-09-14): initial model load takes very long, and live captions lag (often only appear after each sentence ends).

Root causes found:
1. Live STT (Moonshine Base, non-streaming) re-decodes the whole VAD utterance (up to 15 s) every 1.2 s of new audio, then again at utterance end (packages/provider-local/src/live-provider.ts runStt). Quadratic cost; >=1.2 s algorithmic lag even on fast V8 (Node harness: first caption 2.3 s on jfk.wav).
2. ComputeScheduler drops interim captions at level 1 (median RTF > 0.8); short utterances have inflated RTF, so captions degrade to final-only.
3. All workers load the onnxruntime-web asyncify build (ort-env.ts; transformers.js imports onnxruntime-web/webgpu statically), even for WASM-only sessions. Measured in the jsc shell (WebKitGTK 2.52.6 JSC, 1 thread, ORT 1.29, our cached models) plain vs asyncify: Moonshine q4 decoder session create 0.6 s vs 5.1 s; first encoder run on 2 s audio 0.17 s vs 8.0 s; steady encoder RTF 0.07 vs 0.12; Silero 0.40 vs 0.58 ms/window. In Node (V8) the builds are similar, so the harness hides it. JSC = simulator and iOS WKWebView. The simulator's earlier 34.6 s Moonshine load and VAD RTF 2.1 are NOT fully explained by this; something else in the WebKit web process too.
4. Simulator has no SharedArrayBuffer and the packaged Even app is likely not cross-origin isolated, so WASM is single-threaded.

Plan: Phase A quick wins on current stack; Phase B move live STT to Moonshine v2 Streaming via @moonshine-ai/moonshine-wasm (MIT, incremental encoder/decoder caching; published speech-end latency Pixel 10a native: Tiny 92 ms, Small 234 ms, Medium 420 ms; WER Small 7.84%, Medium 6.65% vs Base 10.07%) gated by a single-thread build spike; Phase C perceived load.
Rejected: Nemotron 3.5 streaming 0.6B (too heavy for 1 phone thread), sherpa-onnx streaming Zipformer (fallback only: lower accuracy, no punctuation, no ja), Whisper streaming (no caching), WebGPU for live STT (per-dispatch overhead).

title: Real-time local captions: fast model load and truly live STT
